tool_input.command: cat lean-toolchain && ls && ls .lake/packages 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.elan/toolchains 2>/dev/null | head

python3 tools.py goals probe.lean | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
s=d['sites'][1]
print(s.get('invocations_truncated'))
for inv in s['invocations']:
    for g in inv['before_goals']:
        lines=g.split('\n')
        # print case name and goal only, plus hyps after post
        print('---'); print('\n'.join(l for l in lines if not l.startswith(('h2 :','m :','h1 :','ty :','  Lambda.Identifier','post :')) ))
"
tool_input.description: Print goals before the final simp

tool_input.command: python3 tools.py goals probe.lean > probe_goals.json; wc -c probe_goals.json
tool_input.description: Save probe goal output to workspace file

tool_input.command: cp probe.lean best_funind.lean && python3 tools.py status | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print({k:v for k,v in d.items() if k!='best_proof'}); print(d.get('best_proof'))"
tool_input.description: Save best and query tool status

claude_result.result:
```lean
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  suffices (fun L => ∀ e, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars e ⊆ L → Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars (substOld h2 _ e) ⊆ L) _ from this post (List.subset_append_left ..)
  intro e
  fun_induction substOld <;> simp only [↓imp_self, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.append_subset] <;> repeat' first | assumption | apply And.imp | intro; apply List.subset_append_right
```
